recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it finishes the approved rename on built source surfaces without broadening the change beyond module labels.
issue_request: FHIR-14947 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for the STU3 Clinical Summary module page asking to rename the section title to Clinical Module because Clinical Summary could be misunderstood as a document type.
initial_application: Commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92 explicitly included GF#14947 and changed source/clinicalsummary-module.html from Clinical Summary Module to Clinical Module in the title, h2, introduction, and index text.
additional_context: The current main module page already used Clinical Module, but source/hierarchy.xml still labeled the navigation page Clinical Summary and later Diagnostics module source had two links labeled Clinical Summary Module. publish.ini lists both clinicalsummary-module.html and diagnostics-module.html as current published/special pages. Later same-area issues FHIR-40584 and FHIR-50920 did not reverse the FHIR-14947 rename.
reconciliation: Changed source/hierarchy.xml to title the page Clinical and changed both source/diagnostics-module.html links to read Clinical Module, while preserving the stable clinicalsummary-module.html filename and leaving unrelated clinical summary document-type wording alone.
source_changes: source/hierarchy.xml: changed the clinical module page-tree title from Clinical Summary to Clinical.
source/diagnostics-module.html: changed two Clinical Summary Module link labels to Clinical Module.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same 2018 Clinical Summary Module typo-fix commit, already audited separately and not decided here.
Later Clinical page QA updated the current page content but preserved Clinical Module wording and did not supersede this rename.
Later Diagnostics module work introduced an active Clinical Summary Module link label that this reconciliation aligned with FHIR-14947.
